_comment: Maps GoMarble's server-side skills (the load_skill catalog in mcp-server-sse: ads-mcp-server/src/lib/langfuse/langfuse.json) to plugin skills. Run scripts/sync-server-skills.mjs to refresh. Bodies are copied verbatim; the script only adds frontmatter, rewrites server paths to plugin skill names, and prepends a Claude adapter note where the server text assumes GoMarble's own app.

skills.description: Use when analyzing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad performance: account type detection, Pareto analysis, baselines, performance thresholds, issue diagnosis.
Use when analyzing Meta ad creative performance: Hook Rate / Hold Rate diagnostics, fatigue scoring (Healthy / Early Warning / Fatigued / Dead), format rules, variation strategy.
Use on Meta audits and optimization reviews to go beyond surface metrics: hierarchical drill-down, objective-aware KPIs, breakdowns, trends, funnel dependencies, attribution rigor.
Read before making any Meta Ads recommendation or change: budget-control rules, top-performer protection, scaling limits, stop rules, and safety wording for changes.

Foundation tool reference for any Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads task: Marketing API quirks, pagination, date ranges, entity relationships, currency handling. Use whenever calling GoMarble's facebook_* tools.
Use when running Meta Ads changes as an agentic loop: sequencing reads, proposals and approvals, verifying results after a change is applied.

Read before any Meta audit, pause, scale or optimization-event change on a sales campaign that optimizes for COMPLETE_REGISTRATION or another custom event. Detects 3rd-party purchase trackers (Profitmetrics, Triple Whale, Cosmise) so a working campaign isn't misjudged.

Use for any Meta Ads launch or build: a new campaign, ad set, or ads (image, video, carousel, catalog). One-call launch via facebook_propose_create_campaign_structure with approval before anything goes live.
Use on Google Ads audits and optimization reviews: hierarchical drill-down, bid-strategy-aware evaluation, segmentation, trends, brand/PMax cannibalization, attribution rigor.
Read before making any Google Ads recommendation or change: valid budget controls, scaling limits, learning-phase rules, stop triggers, required diagnostics.
Use for Google Ads keyword research: discovering keywords, search volume, top-of-page CPC and competition from real Keyword Planner data, never estimates.
Use to evaluate Performance Max campaigns: maturity gates, 3-day vs 3-day anomaly checks, asset labels, PMax vs Search comparison.
Use when deciding whether and how to scale a Performance Max campaign, disciplined against overcorrection.
Use when analyzing Google Ads Search campaigns: Q1-Q5 search term classification, rank vs budget auction pressure, CPC inflation diagnosis, decision matrix.
Use when making changes to Google Ads Search campaigns: bid adjustments, budget changes, negatives, query isolation, with the right propose tool for each.
Use for Google Shopping and Merchant Center performance: feed health gate, SKU classification (KILL / DOWNGRADE / PROMOTE), negatives, budget decisions.
Foundation tool reference for any Google Ads task: GAQL patterns, resources, micros, account and MCC structure. Use whenever calling GoMarble's google_ads_* tools.

Use for any Google Ads build or change: new Search campaigns, ad groups, RSAs, assets, experiments, shared negative keyword lists, bid modifiers, and PMax asset groups, with approval before anything goes live.

Use for any TikTok Ads launch: a new campaign, ad group or ads, catalog and Smart+ campaigns. Creative-first, placement-aware, one-call launch via tiktok_propose_create_campaign_structure with approval before anything goes live.
Use for any GA4 analysis or when reconciling ad-platform conversions with analytics: conversions vs transactions, channel-subset-sum traps, attribution discipline.
Use for any Shopify revenue, order, product or customer analysis, and when comparing ad-platform revenue to store revenue: gross vs net, refunds, multi-currency, no financial_status filter traps.
Use for organic search and SEO questions from Google Search Console: organic growth, ranking and CTR opportunities, traffic drops, indexing issues, content priorities, and paid vs organic overlap.
Use to discover competitors and new creative concepts from the ad library: evergreen (long-running) and breakout (fast-scaling) investment signals.
